Mission Local reported that San Francisco State lecturers were told their classes would be cut starting in spring 2024. The impact varied by department: some lecturers would lose one or two classes, while others would lose their entire workloads. The newsroom reported that lecturers—about 60% of the university’s faculty—faced the largest cuts, amounting to roughly a 30% decrease for most colleges. The article also said the cuts could equal 125 full-time positions.
